payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in speculation detection and scope resolution tasks, including improvements in F1 scores and comparisons between models.

claims.text: Substantial improvements were reported over previously reported results by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa in the context of speculation detection, contrary to results on other benchmark datasets.
The CoNLL-2010 Shared Task included speculation cue detection and scope resolution tasks, which have been the subject of extensive prior work.
